title: Greenbelt MakerSpace
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Greenbelt Makerspace and Tool Library is a non-profit cooperative that loans tools and provides a workspace for members to use. For a small membership fee, you can borrow tools for home repair, gardening, sewing, cooking, and more. The Makerspace room is available during Open Hours for you to work on your own projects with our tools.
